patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Beehiiv and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Beehiiv and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Beehiiv only if your buying job matches “Newsletter growth and publication platform with monetization, referrals, and audience tool” rather than Mailjet's shape. Choose Mailjet only if your buying job matches “EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricin” rather than Beehiiv's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Beehiiv is shaped for Newsletter growth and publication platform with monetization, referral whereas Mailjet is shaped for EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending wit. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Beehiiv and Mailjet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Beehiiv is Newsletter growth and publication platform with monetization, referrals, and audience tools — adjacent to classic ESPs.; Mailjet is EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-volume pricing (Sinch)..
- Researched limits: Beehiiv — Publication/growth platform — not a classic multichannel ecommerce ESP; Mailjet — Free plan daily send cap (200/day).

Limitations — Beehiiv: Publication/growth platform — not a classic multichannel ecommerce ESP; Automation depth trails ActiveCampaign-class ESPs; Mailjet: Free plan daily send cap (200/day); Automation depth concentrates on Premium+.

Poor-fit cases: Beehiiv is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Publication/growth platform — not a classic multichannel ecommerce ESP · Mailjet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free plan daily send cap (200/day) · Avoid Beehiiv if you actually need Mailjet's motion (EU-friendly email platform for marketing and transactional sending with send-vol)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
